observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with visible components: intake manifold, valve cover, oil pan, and various hoses and wires. The engine appears dirty and used, with some rust and grime.

Photo 1 shows the same engine from a slightly different angle, revealing the front of the engine with the alternator, throttle body, and various electrical connectors. The engine block has yellow paint marks, possibly from a previous repair or marking.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components in either photo.
The watermark 'PROVISE AUTO VENTURE' is present on both photos, suggesting a seller or listing platform.
The engine is not running; no signs of operation are visible.
The seller claims 'direct Japanese products' and 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.'
